Describe the few minutes just before and after an outdoor event is ruined by the weather.
OR

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Imagine you find yourself accidentally locked in a shopping centre or mall after it has closed
for the day. Describe what you see and hear, and your thoughts and feelings as you wait to
be released.
Narrative Writing

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Write a story with the title, ‘Moving On’.
OR
3 (b) Write a story which includes the words, ‘I smiled when I recalled the events of the day.’
